sources: Eternal Xiranite, 3-piece set skill passive_equipsuit_usp_02 (rmxlinux Json/SkillData, values from SkillPatchTable): buff_equipsuit_usp_02 abilityEvent 102 + CheckBuffIdInContext with four tags (Amp, Protection, Susceptibility, Weakness): when the wearer applies a buff of those kinds, buff_equipsuit_usp_02_AddAttack gives every other teammate DMG Dealt +dmg_up for `duration`. No source-skill check. Logged: equipsuit_usp_02_AddAttack 0.16 on Arcane from Liino's set (btl_upload_d9e59d0fb737).
Categories come from the kit buffs' modifiers (zone amp / susceptibility, attributes 62 / 63), so only effects written as kit buffs trigger it.
